title: Sodium–albumin interaction did not establish improved elevated-CRP prediction across independently recruited US health surveys
abstract: In complete-case adults from NHANES III (n=14,402) and NHANES 2017–2018 (n=4,593), adding a sodium-by-albumin spline interaction to a flexible additive model changed weighted Brier score for CRP>3 mg/L from 0.172372 to 0.172771, delta +0.000398 (joint source-target PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.000212,+0.003199]). The registered improvement criterion failed. Stronger source-selected regularization produced a small exploratory improvement without confirmatory uncertainty. These findings neither establish a useful new biomarker nor exclude small predictive benefit.
